description: Election Commission - S. M. I. W. S. Senevirathna was Selected as the member of the Udunuwara Pradeshiya Sabha - B. M. S. K. Kumari was Selected as the member of the Kanthale Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of vacancies in local government bodies (Kanthale Pradeshiya Sabha and Udunuwara Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically addresses electoral processes for local authorities, including declarations of vacancies and the nomination of replacement members by political parties. This falls squarely under "Electoral processes and related matters" as defined for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
